suitelet.name: SUST - Scale Kiosk
suitelet.description: The scale kiosk IS the scale system for the demo: enter ticket number, truck, supplier, open PO, and gross/tare weights; on submit it creates the scale ticket and transforms the PO into the Item Receipt (weights + lot = ticket number), firing the receipt automation chain. Duplicate ticket numbers are blocked. Corrections re-sync weights to the receipt.
